reviews.text:
I am grateful for the care I receive from the doctors here.

However, I really wish they would improve the reservation system.

Even with a reservation, the wait is very long, making the reservation system completely pointless. Wouldn't it be better to just accept patients on a first-come, first-served basis? Time is limited.

My beloved dog has a serious illness, and we've been receiving care at this hospital for a long time.

They always genuinely care about my dog ​​and patiently address my anxieties and questions. Their diagnoses and treatment plans are accurate, and they consider the best course of action based on my dog's condition at each stage, so I feel completely at ease entrusting my dog ​​to them.

Having been a patient here for so long, I also feel that the fees are reasonable and fair.

They are a very trustworthy doctor who not only understands the illness but also empathizes with the feelings and thoughts of the owner. I am truly grateful to have found a hospital where I can entrust my dog ​​with such confidence.

I've owned dogs for 30 years, and I consider this to be the hospital I feel most comfortable going to.

The veterinarians and all the staff prioritize the well-being of dogs, providing kind, attentive care and making it a hospital where you can entrust your dog with complete peace of mind. I am grateful every day.

I've been relying on this veterinary clinic for my beloved cat for over 10 years.

All the staff members genuinely love animals, and they always treat me with care and respect. They conduct thorough examinations every time, and explain the results and future treatment plans clearly and concisely, which instills great confidence in me.

Even when I need to visit an emergency hospital late at night, they have a system in place to ensure smooth information sharing and seamless transition of treatment, which is incredibly reassuring.

When my cat passed away, they provided compassionate and attentive care until the very end. This is a truly wonderful animal hospital that I highly recommend, a place that has been a trusted partner for many years.
The doctors and nurses are so kind that my child doesn't mind going to the hospital. I always feel at ease entrusting my child's care to them because of their accurate diagnoses. Thank you so much.

Wakamatsuya Shoten,

Thank you very much for your kind and high rating.

We are all very pleased that you felt that way.

We, the veterinarians and staff, will continue to strive to provide careful examinations and clear explanations so that families and pet owners can visit us with peace of mind.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

Tsurumaki Animal Hospital

The examinations are thorough, which is wonderful considering there are animal hospitals that operate on a low-profit, high-volume model, seeing only one animal in 10 minutes. They provide careful and attentive care, including examinations. As expected from a veterinarian who graduated from Nippon Veterinary and Life Science University.
I'm so glad I found this hospital.

I have been receiving treatment here for over 10 years.
I feel truly lucky to have found this hospital. Several of my acquaintances also come here, and they all say it's a great hospital.
I look forward to continuing to receive your support.

Dear Yuko Tsumura

Thank you very much for your positive review.

We will continue to provide attentive medical care so that pet owners and their families can rest easy.

Please feel free to contact us at any time with any questions or concerns.

Tsurumaki Animal Hospital

When I got home from work, my dog ​​was breathing strangely and vomiting. My usual vet was closed, so even though it was our first visit, I called at 6:40 PM (they close at 7:00 PM).
I didn't expect them to see us because of the time, but they kindly saw us, which was a great help.
The head veterinarian's explanations were clear and easy to understand, making us feel very confident in their services.
They also offered advice on spaying and soft palate surgery for an adult dog, which other clinics had refused, so we plan to have that done here.

[December 2025 Update]
We had spaying and soft palate surgery performed in October.
The pre-operative examination explanations were thorough and easy to understand, and our family felt completely at ease entrusting our dog to them.
On the day of the surgery, they contacted us immediately after our dog woke up from anesthesia and extracted four teeth because she was developing periodontal disease.
Currently, we are receiving treatment for cystitis, and because it is prone to recurrence, they suggested treating the causative bacteria.

The previous hospital we went to would schedule weekly appointments on the spot under the pretext of follow-up, and would try to upsell us to buy Royal Canin and other hospital-affiliated pet food. Tsurumaki Hospital, however, does none of that, and their fees are very reasonable.

We've found a great hospital.

Our dog is very healthy now; before, we couldn't let him run around because we were worried about his breathing, but now he can run around without panting at all. I'm so glad we entrusted him to Tsurumaki Hospital.

The waiting room isn't very big, so it can get quite crowded at certain times, but it's very relaxing to see all the dogs and cats.

We sometimes see rabbits there, so it seems they also treat exotic animals. Amazing!

We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.
I wasn't diagnosed with heart disease. When I went to another hospital, they said it was clearly heart disease, and I passed away soon after. I learned the importance of getting a second opinion.

We've been taking care of our pets, including our previous one, since 2020.

We've been seeing the associate director, who is a wonderful veterinarian who truly cares for animals. The director explains blood test results clearly and empathetically to pet owners, and seeing him wave to the animals with a smile makes me feel incredibly fortunate to have our pets cared for at such a veterinary hospital.

We always hear the director and the veterinary nurses' cheerful smiles and laughter from the reception area, and we leave feeling incredibly happy.

They clearly explain what they can and cannot do (implying that other hospitals are more specialized), making them a truly animal-friendly hospital. I wholeheartedly recommend them.

*Recently, I met someone who, coincidentally, also owns a cat treated by Dr. Suzuki, and I wrote this thinking, "Ah, I knew it!"

I'm so grateful for the reasonable fees they offer, and I wanted to give back through this review. Since becoming part of a company that supports the digital transformation of animal hospitals, I've strived to be an absolute ally of veterinarians who save countless animals, while pursuing both the realities and ideals.

I sincerely hope that Tsurumaki Animal Hospital will have many more wonderful encounters with animals!

All of my cats have been cared for by the doctors here over the years.

This is a wonderful and reliable hospital, where the staff, including the staff themselves, consider not only the cats' well-being but also the feelings of their owners.

The female veterinarian in charge gave thorough explanations and empathized with my anxieties, which put me at ease. I've been going to this hospital for any issues since my cat was a kitten, and I trust the doctor and nurses because they remember my cat's history and medical history from when she was a kitten. When I took my cat to another hospital for an emergency at night, they quickly shared information between hospitals and were able to respond promptly when I came back the next day. I'm glad I chose this hospital.

Since moving to Setagaya, I had a hard time finding a good hospital, so I looked through the Google reviews for the area and finally came across this one. The doctors were calm and gentle, just as the reviews said, and it was great.
My cat is nervous and timid, crying and acting up during appointments, but the director and deputy director handled the situation smoothly, which made me feel very at ease.
My cat is prone to forming crystals in his urine, and other hospitals have often just suggested changing his food, but this hospital clearly explained not only the pros and cons of the food he's currently being fed.
I'm so happy to have finally found a hospital I can go to with confidence. ☺️
Thank you for your attentive service!

Dear Nissy RR

Thank you for your review.

We will continue to strive to provide you with the best possible service.

Please feel free to contact us with any questions you may have.

We look forward to your continued support.

Tsurumaki Animal Hospital

I had been interested in this hospital for some time, and one day something happened that led me to visit. The doctor was very calm and explained things carefully, and I felt he was a very trustworthy doctor. The nurses were also very friendly, and the whole hospital had a warm atmosphere. My dog ​​was well-behaved there, so I decided to continue receiving his care.

Dear Kei Yoshi,

Thank you for the wonderful photos.

Our entire staff is always striving to ensure that pet owners and their beloved family members feel at ease when visiting our clinic.

Please feel free to contact us with any questions or concerns you may have.

Tsurumaki Animal Hospital

Dear Hakurin,

Thank you for your feedback.

We will continue to strive to provide you with satisfactory service in the future.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any problems.

Tsurumaki Animal Hospital
